chronologies.title: Back-End Developer – DASA
chronologies.description: I am currently working as a back-end developer at the largest diagnostic medicine company in Latin America and the fifth largest in the world in the sector. I work on integrating with partner companies, sharing patient data with their consent. I also develop systems for generating medical reports and results for patients. My main contribution was acting as the lead developer in the refactoring of the data-sharing process between partner companies, resulting in significant improvements to the codebase and enabling the company to support millions of requests per day through our API.
